notes.title: Update 20
notes.content:
Added:

Sandbox mode

Peaceful and hardcore difficulties

Photo mode

Loading screen tips

Rotation snapping

Material offset info is changed during world gen and stored in save files. This leads to more varied color patterns on the terrain

New events

New splash texts

New achievements

Buildings make sounds when rotated

New sound and screen effects for when you hit the map's edge

Bug Fixes:

Terrain material color adjustments

Balancing changes for difficulty settings

Certain events can only be triggered on certain difficulties

Slight UI tweaks

Graphics tweaks

Minor performance improvements

The lowest quality setting no longer causes units to move extremely slow

Slight adjustments to building hitboxes

Fixed place multiple not working with bridges

The color settings are now not a longer dropdown menu. Instead, they are text fields where you can put in any hex color value

Buildings now change to green and red during Christmas and Christmas Eve. They also turn orange and black on Halloween

Disabled book resizing for the guide

Place multiple no longer ignore guard camp and fort caps

notes.title: Update 19
notes.content:
Added:

Injured units now leave blood puddles on the ground

Pending buildings now indicate if they can be placed or not

Units make sounds when hurt

Buildings make sounds when damaged

Steam profile picture is now displayed on the main menu

Bug Fixes:

Mild hit box tweaks

Fixed bug where damage healed at noon would not be applied to the save file

Adjusted some tooltips

Spacial audio tweaks

notes.title: Update 18
notes.content:
Added:

New UI animations

New building animations

New enemy and guard animations

Bug Fixes:

Replaced some old textures

Fixed a bug where the text alert made by parks for consumed water would appear below the island

notes.title: Update 17
notes.content:
Added:

Hurricanes

Earthquakes

Lightning

An alert for new players

New natural disaster commands

Bug Fixes:

Your population count will no longer be one lower than it should be upon loading a save

Lighting tweaks

notes.title: Update 16
notes.content:
Added:

Mansions

Nice houses

Graveyards

Cathedrals

Parks

Markets

More events

Efficiency info is now in the info panel

New command that spawns guards

New command that prints the current efficiency to the event log

New skybox

Bug Fixes:

Changed the way the game calculates and applies production efficiency

Increased water used by crops

Adjusted tree hitboxes

Level up messages appear in the event log

Fixed a bug where restaurants wouldn't show water usage

Increased food and water consumed by restaurants

Fixed bugs with health bars

notes.title: Update 15
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:

The town hall will no longer say it doesn't have enough workers if it was generated on top of a rock or tree

UI tweaks

Increased the number of forts and camps you can have by 1

Minor AI improvements including paths no longer causing the AI to freak out and wolves can no longer glide over rivers

Minor improvements to the way the game processes save files

Mild performance improvements

Camp and tent hit box tweaks

notes.title: Update 14
notes.content:
Added:

Resources slowly regenerate over time

New guard camps

Tents

Put a limit on how many forts can be on an island at any given time

New deforest and reforest command

Bug Fixes:

Adjusted spawn rates for battle buildings

Adjusted attack range of the fort

Shader tweaks

The UI button sound no longer plays multiple times at once upon loading a new scene

Slight UI tweaks and fixes including fixes to the event log

Tooltips will no longer stay on screen when they should be hidden

Indicators for battle buildings are no longer part of the building if when determining if you have your mouse over the building

The game more accurately tracks the number of guard towers you have

notes.title: Update 13
notes.content:
Added:

Added a new xp system

Add a new fort building

Added guard units that will fight to protect the city

Added a raid beacon that can be used to force a mega raid to happen

Bug Fixes:

Slight buff to faith buildings

AI tweaks

The "enemy bridge" is now referred to as the "temporary bridge"

Production buildings can't produce resources until placed

Updated the guide book

notes.title: Update 12
notes.content:
Added:

The UI will now point enemies out for you.

Added more achievements.

You can now click on enemies. Doing so will deal a small amount of damage.

A new storage building was added as well as limits on how many of each resource can be stored at a given time.

Added a wolf enemy who does more damage and is a little faster but can't build bridges.

Added a bird enemy that can fly and move faster than the before-mentioned wolf but won't do much damage.

Bug Fixes:

After destroying a building the enemies are less likely to just stand in place doing nothing.

At long last invisible walls exist to prevent the camera from being able to go way off into the distance.

The guide can now be accessed in the pause menu.

The settings menu will no longer automatically reopen itself upon opening the pause menu.

Camera positional data has been added tp the save game data.

notes.title: Update 11
notes.content:
Added:

You can now cancel building by pressing F.

Building placement controls pop up on screen to help you when you have a pending building selected.

Added a build multiple mode for placing several of the same type of building.

Added battle music.

Building nameplates will now appear when you hover your mouse over a building.

Added more diversity to the citizens and enemies. They will now be assigned a random skin tone upon spawning in.

Bug Fixes:

Buildings can no longer be moved during an attack.

Mild tweaks to procedural generation.

notes.title: Update 10
notes.content:
Added:

Enemies can now build bridges to cross rivers. They will not do this if your difficulty is set to easy.

Added a viewable event log.

The game will now add enemy health and position data to the save game data.

The game will now add building health to the save game data.

On loading a save all damaged buildings and enemies will now show their health bars briefly so you know and can see what the health of everything is at the start of your session.

Bug Fixes:

Build/destroy particles are less obscuring.

Resized command window.

Mild tweaks to enemy ai.

notes.title: Update 9
notes.content:
Added:

Enemies now die automatically at noon each day.

New blood particles for hurt enemies.

Buildings now have particle effects for being placed/destroyed.

Floating text now appears to show how much of a resource is being consumed/produced and the text is colored to match whichever resource it is.

notes.title: Update 8
notes.content:
Added:

Added a town hall building that will trigger a game over if destroyed.

Added a range indicator to the guard tower.

Added attack particles to battle buildings.

Added difficulty settings that affect resource gain, resource consumption, enemy stats, and settlement demands.

Added spikes.

Added more island names.

Added more splash texts.

Buildings will now display a red icon if you have too few people for the building to function. The icon will be yellow if you have people working there but the building isn't running at full efficiency.

Enemy attack damage now scales with how many days have passed.

Bug Fixes:

Substantial performance improvements.

Fixed a bug where day counts and attacks wouldn't trigger at midnight.

Fixed a bug where buildings wouldn't repair at noon.

Buildings can't take damage until placed now.

Fixed a bug with bridge placement where its y level would be off. (may break old saves)

Improved AI pathing over bridges.

The trade post will now not work if you don't have a population of at least one.

The nuke command now kills off enemies and removes citizens as well.

Fixed glitches where saving the game right when the game loaded would cause resource counts to not save properly.

AI tweaks have been made to the enemies regarding how they prioritize and pick targets.

Very minor tweaks to the citizen's AI.

notes.title: Update 7
notes.content:
Added:

Every night at midnight attackers may decide to come to destroy your town.

Added guard towers.

Buildings now have a health stat that determines how damaged they are and how quickly they are destroyed. Every day at noon the health is restored to max.

The game now tracks how many days your current play-through has lasted. Note that the more days that pass the more attackers that come.

A game over screen was added.

New enemy-related events.

Added a command that spawns an enemy on a random spot on your island.

Bug Fixes:

Minor adjustments to graphics quality settings.

Some adjustments to the water shader that you'll probably never notice.

Fixed a bug where you wouldn't be able to relocate buildings that'd been placed in a previous session upon loading a save.

notes.title: Update 6
notes.content:
Added:

Support for Spanish

Buildings can now be relocated.

A new ultra graphics quality setting.

Bug Fixes:

Tooltips now size correctly.

Further small UI adjustments.

Fixed an issue where in some very specific situations you could end up with a negative amount of stone. In that situation, your food count would be set to zero.

Post-processing tweaks.

notes.title: Update 5
notes.content:
Added:

The stars system.

More words have been added to the "dictionary" used to generate the randomized names of islands.

Bug Fixes:

UI tweaks and fixes.

notes.title: Update 4
notes.content:
Added:
A new religious building. A simple wooden cross.

100 new splash texts.

Bug Fixes:
While technically not a bug I have changed the color of the event text and made it bold.

notes.title: Update 3
notes.content:
Added:

New event system

New command to force the event system to trigger a new event

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
Added:

A new building that provides joy but also increases work demand. It also consumes both food and water. It's a restaurant!

Now on the main menu if you look to the top right you will find your Steam account name and what game update you're on displayed.

Bug Fixes:

Not necessarily a bug but it's definitely a fix! Corrections to the in-game manual have made it easier to follow. Mostly just grammar, spelling, punctuation, and other adjustments.

notes.title: Update 1
notes.content:
Added:

More music

Object hover outlines

Achievement support

More terrain, edge, and water colors

Bug Fixes:

No longer will the camera be locked in place upon exiting the pause menu without hitting the escape key on your keyboard

Fixed various path-finding glitches with the citizen AI

Corrected very minor texture issues with smoke particles

Ocean waves will no longer rise above the terrain mesh
